subject: CS481
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering key topics in ethics. One topic (Rule Utilitarianism) had no suitable Arabic candidates. Selections prioritize relevance, educational quality, and high view counts as a proxy for peer validation.

coverage.note: Very few relevant candidates found; selected the best available option which explains the concept through the Trolley Problem.
No relevant candidates found in the provided list for this topic in Arabic.

coverage.topic: Social Contract Theory and Rawls's Principles
Social Contract Theory and Rawls's Principles

videos.title: Kant & Categorical Imperatives: Crash Course Philosophy #35
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive, well-animated, and highly popular video that clearly explains Kant's key concepts for a university audience.

videos.title: BENTHAM'S UTILITARIANISM and the HEDONISTIC CALCULUS
videos.filter_reason: This video specifically focuses on Bentham's Act Utilitarianism and the Hedonic Calculus, directly addressing the student difficulty of 'calculating utility'.

videos.title: Act Utilitarianism vs Rule Utilitarianism vs Two-Level Utilitarianism (Explanation & Differences)
videos.filter_reason: An excellent and clear explanation of the differences between Act and Rule Utilitarianism, which is crucial for addressing common student confusion.

videos.title: POLITICAL THEORY - John Rawls
videos.topic_en: Social Contract Theory and Rawls's Principles
videos.filter_reason: A highly engaging and visually clear explanation of Rawls's theory, with a specific focus on the 'veil of ignorance' concept.

videos.title: 3.1 Ethical and psychological egoism (8:28)
videos.filter_reason: A concise, academic video that directly explains the crucial distinction between psychological and ethical egoism, a common point of confusion.

videos.title: ايمانويل كانط والفلسفة الاخلاقية
videos.filter_reason: A detailed and highly-viewed lecture that provides a thorough explanation of Kant's moral philosophy suitable for university students.

videos.title: معضلة القطار  - نظرية اخلاقية
videos.filter_reason: While not a direct theoretical explanation, this video on the Trolley Problem is the best available option and effectively demonstrates utilitarian calculation in practice.

videos.title: المساواة أم العدل ؟ حجاب الجهل - The Veil of Ignorance | ريبلز 94
videos.topic_en: Social Contract Theory and Rawls's Principles
videos.filter_reason: This video is perfectly targeted, as its title 'The Veil of Ignorance' addresses the most difficult concept in Rawls's theory for students.

videos.title: الدحيح - فضيلة الأنانية
videos.filter_reason: An extremely popular and high-quality video from Al-Daheeh that explains ethical egoism through Ayn Rand's 'The Virtue of Selfishness'.
